added: 67510: OpenLM Platform Workstation Agent can now run either elevated or non-elevated based on the permissions.runAsElevated setting, showing a User Access Control (UAC) prompt only when enabled.
64672: Process Manager now supports command-line launch arguments and window title monitoring.
61308: Added an automatic mass update mechanism for Workstation Agent.
fixed: 68556: Fixed an issue where Workstation Agent process is terminated after an upgrade and fails to start again.
66546: Fixed an issue where the Installer did not show the Use Dongle Monitoring checkbox in Cloud mode.
66129: Fixed an error in Agents Hub that could show "Product not activated" when Dongle Monitoring is off.
65897: Fixed an issue where Workstation Agent did not pick up changes to a project environment variable after the initial read.

updated: 62604: Dongle Monitoring communication now uses WebSockets instead of HTTP.
fixed: 64994: Resolved an issue where dongle sessions were not recreated after a computer resumed from sleep.
improved: 65290: When installed under the SYSTEM account (e.g., via SCCM), Workstation Agent now automatically starts under the logged-in interactive user.
